wording.title: Split into any grid
wording.description: Grows Edge's own split past two panes: add panes on any side, drag the dividers, move with Shift+Alt+arrow. Live, no restart. Open Edge first.

wording.title: Live tab preview on hover
wording.description: Hover a tab and its thumbnail plays live instead of a frozen snapshot, by keeping Edge's own tab capture running while the preview is open. Live, no restart. Open Edge first.

wording.title: Theme by Windows light and dark
wording.description: Use one theme when Windows is light and another when it is dark, switched live. Add themes from the Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons or a local file.

labels.storeLinkPlaceholder: Paste a Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons link
labels.reorderHelp: Drag a theme, or press Alt+Up or Alt+Down, to move it in this list and in the pickers.

wording.title: Cut-corner tabs
wording.description: Gives every tab, vertical and horizontal, a straight leading edge and a cut trailing corner, with the selected tab filled in the theme's neon. Works with Theming on. Live, no restart.

wording.title: Settings and extensions pages follow the theme
wording.description: Makes edge://settings and edge://extensions light or dark to match your Edge theme, not Windows. Only those two pages change; websites are untouched. Live, no restart. Open Edge first.

wording.title: Reading mode follows Windows light and dark
wording.description: Reading mode uses one page theme while Windows is light and another while it is dark, switched as Windows switches. Pick both in reading mode: Appearance settings, Themes, then Light mode or Dark mode. Live, no restart.

wording.title: Enhanced find: RegExp and Ask Copilot
wording.description: Adds RegExp (with its flags) and Ask Copilot to the options of Edge's Ctrl+F bar. RegExp highlights every match; Ask sends your question to Copilot, which opens in its side panel. Live, no restart. Open Edge first.

wording.title: Ask to handle links, like Chrome
wording.description: Like Chrome: when a site such as Gmail offers to open email or calendar links, closing the bubble no longer blocks it for good; only Ignore or Block does. Turning this on lifts earlier blocks. Live, no restart.

wording.title: Hide the developer-mode prompt
wording.description: Stops Edge asking to turn off developer-mode extensions when it starts. Takes effect from Edge's next start.

wording.title: Start Edge+ when Windows starts
wording.description: Runs Edge+ in the background, with no window, from when you sign in to Windows: your settings apply and an Edge update that needs a newer Edge+ is caught. Launch Edge+ to open its window.

wording.title: Inject automatically
wording.description: Puts Edge+ into Edge each time Edge starts. Off, Edge starts without it and Edge+ offers an Inject button.

wording.title: Check for updates
wording.description: Looks for a new Edge+ release on GitHub and offers to restart into it. Off, Edge+ never contacts GitHub.

dropHint: Drop a theme folder, .zip or .crx to add it
